## Summary

Describe the change and the user-visible outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Added or updated deterministic tests where behavior changed.

## Product and data integrity

- [ ] Demo data remains clearly labeled and is not presented as live telemetry.
- [ ] Live Mode continues to show only data retrieved from a verified Flagsmith connection.
- [ ] No privileged credential or sensitive user data is included.
- [ ] Accessibility and responsive behavior were considered.
- [ ] Flagsmith-related claims link to supported documentation and use only supported operations.

## Manual checks / known limitations

Describe additional checks, whether a real Flagsmith environment was used, and any remaining limitations.
